full_judgment: 2. Ganesh Pada Parial as plaintiff instituted Partition Suit No. 87 of 1969 against Priya Bandhu Bhattacherjee, Nirmal Chandra Bhattacherjee, Haripada Parialand Nirode Baran. His case was that the disputed land measuring 1.51 acres appertaining to RS khatian No. 966 and 4072 of Mouza Paschim Guzara under PS Roazan, District Chittagong originally belonged to Nabin Chandra and Pran Krishna in moiety share. On the death of Nabin Chandra his sons Priya Bandhan (defendant No. 1), and Anath Bandhan inherited the land and on the death of Pran Krishna Nirmal Chandra, defendant No.2 and Nirode Baran defendant No, 4 inherited his share. Anath Bandhu and Nirode Baransold their 8 annas share in the disputed land to the plaintiff by two registered kabalas dated 1004.52 which he purchased in the benami of his son Haripada Parial, the defendant No.3, with his own money and for his own benefit and possessed the suit land without partition by metes and bounds. The plaintiffs demand for partition was refused by defendant Nos. 1 and 2 leading to the institution of the present suit.
